name: TWO_WAY_TRAFFIC_YELLOW_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. W8-SA103 300 x 300, R25, 4 / 12 (edge 4 + border 8). Two arrows 'W8-15 @ 50 %' 200 long (50/200/50): the upper pointing right, centre line 55 from the top, the lower pointing left 70 below (y 125) — the AS 1743 W8-15 arrow at half size as polygons. TWO WAY 40 D baseline 210 (125 + 85), 235 overall (32/235/33; word gap set to span 235); TRAFFIC 40 D baseline 270 (60 pitch, 30 below), 205 (47/205/48). Only with G9-SA121; Technical Services to be contacted.
